samples.question: Starting at the red disk and moving along the one connected dark thread toward the gold triangle, replace each of its five closed loops by a point at the center of that loop. Connect the five center points in travel order with straight segments. Relative to the red-to-gold direction, which path appears: arch, cup, or wave? An arch has one middle bulge to the left of travel, a cup has one middle bulge to the right, and a wave crosses from a left bulge to a right bulge. Answer ambiguous if the two closest patterns tie.
